title: MailDignity — Fix Your AI Outbound. Save Your Reputation.
excerpt: The dignity filter for AI outbound emails. Catch bot flattery, awkward asks and pushy AI copy before they burn your reputation, your domain and your leads.

The dignity filter for your LLMs. At any scale.
Catch bot flattery. Cut awkward asks. Ban AI arrogance.

00 / INTRODUCING MAILDIGNITY APISLOP IN. DIGNITY OUT.

Stop AI hallucinating empathy.

Scale outbound with AI and you scale the slop too. It’s easy to send thousands of LLM-generated cold emails, but every prospect who hits 'Report Spam' burns your domain and ruins your leads.

MailDignity is the independent safety layer between your LLM and your reputation. It catches AI slop before you hit send and tells the model how to fix it, so you can scale outbound, stay out of the spam folder and make people want to answer.

“I hope this email finds you well” never really worked. Make people want to answer instead.

  • 01

    Catch

    Flags the phrases that make a prospect think “AI wrote this”.

  • 02

    Explain

    Tells your LLM exactly what to change, not just that it failed.

  • 03

    Verify

    Re-checks every rewrite until it earns a PASS.

01 / A SANITY CHECK FOR YOUR SEND BUTTONNOT ANOTHER AI WRITER.

Don't just land in the inbox.
Land like a human.

You already have plenty of AI writing assistants. MailDignity isn't another one.
If you think this is just another AI wrapper, you'd better think again. MailDignity uses deterministic filters with fixed rules to stop AI slop from simulating forced familiarity, inventing diagnoses, and embarrassing your brand. Only then, multiple smart AI layers analyze your message and context, blocking poor phrasing before it harms your reputation.
MailDignity checks, reviews, and fixes your outbound, guiding every message toward higher conversion. Powered by cold math, not just warm AI.

02 / IT'S AN APIONE ENDPOINT. THOUSAND CHECKS.

API & MCP

MailDignity is an API. Call it before every send.
Works wonders via MCP with your favourite agent.
From code or your no-code stack. Works anywhere you can send an HTTP request. Read the docs

[ Lead Data ]→[ GPT / Claude ]→[ MailDignity API ]

PASSStraight to your sequencer

Human, specific, easy to decline. The original goes to Instantly or Smartlead untouched.

REVIEWFixed before it ships

A heavy ask or a stiff line. You get repaired_body: same facts, same voice, ready to send in its place.

FAILHeld, not burned

Guilt trips, fake urgency, made-up familiarity. It never leaves your queue until a person rewrites it.

✳ ALSO VIA MCP

Prefer an agent? Add MailDignity to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor. The model writes the email, calls check_email, applies the fix and gives you the clean version. No copy-paste, no API key. How to connect.


One API call between your generation prompt and your send queue, to save you from later embarrassments.

03 / THE DELIVERABILITY TRAP

Deliverability gets you in.
Dignity gets a reply.

SPF, DKIM and "warm-up" get your emails past the filters. Then a human reads... and hits 'Report Spam'.
People spot AI slop in a heartbeat. It costs you sales and trust. MailDignity is here to help.
